# Beta119 — device recovery, window checks and settings links

- Recover native command retries interrupted by a restart or service failure.
  Reconciliation uses the most recent retry and verified device feedback,
  preserving the original attempt limits and physical settling protections.
- Keep a window sensor assigned to another room out of this room's control
  policy even when its live state is missing. Missing local contacts still
  require valid evidence, and the existing closure recovery delay is retained.
- Refresh dashboard settings links when the selected source or Home Assistant
  connection changes. Retired registry replies and failures cannot restore old
  device links, block a new request, or delay its retry.

The existing comfort algorithms, profile defaults and humidity targets are
retained. Focused regression tests reproduce these failures alongside the
existing Home Assistant, controller and browser validation.

Update through HACS, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the dashboard to load
the corrected card.
